Game Overview

PlanetUp puts players into a skill experience centered on navigate your very own planet through the cosmos in PlanetUp, dodging asteroids and collecting powerful upgrades. With simple controls and a stunning universe, unlock 90 unique planets and encounter endless challenges. Strategize to survive longer and embrace an addictive, ever-expanding galactic journey.
